assessment.nobel_worthiness: Halide perovskite absorbers took solar cells from a few percent to above 25% efficiency in about a decade, and opened a new class of defect-tolerant, solution-processable semiconductors that also drives LEDs and detectors. The chemistry is original: tunable ABX3 compositions and crystal engineering. Impact on materials chemistry is very broad.
assessment.attribution: Miyasaka reported the first perovskite-sensitized cell, Park and Snaith made the solid-state, efficient devices that launched the field. Kanatzidis, Grätzel and Seok also made major contributions, so any three-person selection leaves clear omissions. Credit among them is genuinely contested.
assessment.maturity: Efficiencies are independently confirmed worldwide and the structural chemistry is well understood. Long-term operational stability and lead toxicity are unresolved, so commercial maturity is still partial, though the scientific discovery is mature enough for recognition.
uncertainties: Whether stability problems will limit real-world deployment and make recognition premature
Fair three-person allocation among Miyasaka, Park, Snaith, Seok, Grätzel and Kanatzidis
Early contributions such as Kojima's are not in the supplied credited names

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editors chemically convert one base into another on DNA without double-strand breaks, by fusing deaminases to Cas9 nickases and engineering evolved enzymes. This is a new molecular-editing concept with major therapeutic and research use, and it is clearly chemistry in its design and protein evolution.
assessment.attribution: Liu led the conceptual and experimental work; Komor and Gaudelli were first authors of the cytosine and adenine base editor papers. Liu is the necessary laureate. Kondo and Nishida independently developed a related cytidine deaminase tool (Target-AID), which complicates attribution.
assessment.maturity: Widely reproduced, with first clinical trials and patient treatments under way. Long-term safety, off-target deamination and delivery remain open, but recognition is timely given the speed of adoption.
uncertainties: Possible overlap with a genome-editing prize already given (CRISPR, 2020)
Whether Komor and Gaudelli or the Kondo and Nishida group belong in the prize
Long-term clinical outcomes still accumulating

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Targeted protein degradation uses bifunctional PROTACs and molecular glues to recruit E3 ligases and remove proteins, a new pharmacological principle that gives access to targets considered undruggable. The chemistry of heterobifunctional design and ternary complex structure is original and has reshaped drug discovery.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies introduced the PROTAC concept; Crews developed small-molecule PROTACs; Ciulli provided VHL ligands and structural basis of ternary complexes. Glue degraders (thalidomide mechanism by Handa, Ito, Gray, Ebert and others) form a separate strand. Allocation is difficult with eight credited names and several decisive contributors.
assessment.maturity: Many degraders are in clinical trials and ligase and ternary complex mechanisms have been confirmed independently. No approved PROTAC drug yet, so clinical validation is incomplete, though the concept itself is well established.
uncertainties: No approved PROTAC drug yet; clinical value not fully proven
PROTACs and molecular glues may need separate recognition
Many deserving contributors outside a three-person prize

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Orthogonal aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase and tRNA pairs allow site-specific incorporation of unnatural amino acids in living cells, expanding the genetic code. It is original, general chemistry applied to biology and is used widely in protein engineering, imaging, and therapeutics.
assessment.attribution: Schultz, with Wang, established the first in vivo unnatural amino acid incorporation in E. coli and later in eukaryotes. Chin extended the work to multicellular organisms and to quadruplet codons and orthogonal ribosomes. Yokoyama and Mehl also contributed. Schultz is the principal figure.
assessment.maturity: Method has been confirmed in many laboratories for over two decades and is mature. Timeliness is good; this is a long-pending field with stable interpretation.
uncertainties: Credit overlap with Yokoyama, Mehl and others
Whether the discovery is judged chemistry rather than biology

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Carbon nanotubes are a foundational nanomaterial, with remarkable structural, electronic and mechanical properties. Iijima's 1991 observation by electron microscopy and the 1993 single-walled tube discovery launched a major field. As someone who works on structure determination by electron microscopy and diffraction, I value that the structure was identified directly by imaging.
assessment.attribution: Iijima identified multi-walled tubes (1991) and, independently with Bethune's group at IBM, single-walled tubes (1993). Endo earlier observed hollow carbon fibres, an arguably earlier precedent that is disputed. Iijima has the strongest claim; Bethune is a plausible second.
assessment.maturity: Decades of confirmation and wide applications in composites and electronics, though large-scale applications are still limited. Recognition is long overdue and some may consider the window passing, with fullerenes already recognised in 1996.
uncertainties: Priority questions between Iijima and earlier Russian or Japanese observations
Prize partly lost to the fullerene award, and possible physics overlap
Limited commercial impact compared with early expectations

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Template-directed ordered mesoporous silica (M41S, MCM-41) extended molecular-sieve chemistry into the 2 to 50 nm range using surfactant liquid-crystal templating, and led to SBA-15, KIT-6 and many later materials. It is original and has had broad use in catalysis, adsorption and delivery. I note that this is close to my own research area, so I try to judge it conservatively.
assessment.attribution: Kresge and Beck at Mobil discovered MCM-41; Ryoo extended to ordered carbons and different structures; Stucky and Zhao developed SBA-15 and related materials; Inagaki made periodic mesoporous organosilicas, with Yanagisawa's earlier related work not in the list. Credit is broad and contested.
assessment.maturity: Highly confirmed and structurally well characterised, but the field has matured and practical industrial impact is modest relative to zeolites. Timeliness is uncertain, since its peak influence may have passed.
uncertainties: Industrial impact smaller than zeolites
Fair credit among Mobil, Japanese and Stucky and Zhao groups
Potential personal proximity to the field

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Serial femtosecond crystallography at X-ray free-electron lasers allows structure determination from nanocrystals before radiation damage, and time-resolved studies of reactions in real time. It extends the structure-from-small-crystals problem, which I know well from electron diffraction, and gives access to difficult membrane proteins.
assessment.attribution: Chapman led the first demonstrations (2011) with Fromme (Photosystem I nanocrystals) and others; Schlichting developed time-resolved work. Hajdu's earlier concept is noted, and I am not certain of his current status; Spence and others are not in the credited names. Credit is shared among a large team.
assessment.maturity: Many independent XFEL facilities confirm the method, though throughput and access are limited. The technology is still developing and its reach into chemistry is narrower than that of cryo-EM, which was recognised in 2017.
uncertainties: Limited access to XFEL facilities and unclear chemical breadth
Possible overlap with prior recognition of structural methods
Hajdu's status and Spence's absence from the credited names

assessment.nobel_worthiness: MXenes are a large family of 2D transition-metal carbides and nitrides made by selective etching of MAX phases, with a tunable surface chemistry and applications in energy storage, electromagnetic shielding and catalysis. The family is original, and the layered structures are well established by diffraction and microscopy.
assessment.attribution: Naguib, Gogotsi and Barsoum reported Ti3C2 in 2011; the three form a natural, clear trio. Credit is clearer than for most candidates.
assessment.maturity: The field is young and growing quickly; confirmation is wide, but fundamental importance is less established relative to older candidates. Likely premature, though not far from consideration.
uncertainties: Impact may be premature
Real-world applications are still unproven
Overlap with graphene-based materials awards
